Observations worth flagging:

- **T1 vs T5 comparison is incomplete.** T1 (named verifier) failed on an API safeguard rejection (`[cyber]`), not a hook — so this run gives no evidence on whether a named verifier spawn gets the degraded tool profile. That's an infra failure; I can respawn T1 with the same brief if you want the data point (the "echo … > file" + "verifier" wording may be what tripped the classifier — rewording would likely avoid it).
- **Explore (T4) returned no `agentId`** in its hand-back, unlike T2/T3/T5 — possibly an artefact of the named/teammate spawn path.
- **T4 and T5 tool lists differ from the advertised definitions.** Explore reported no `Glob`/`Grep`/`Edit`/`Write`; the unnamed verifier reported `Read, WebFetch, Bash` without `Glob`/`Grep` (its definition lists them). Whether that's accurate self-reporting or just omission by the agent is unverified.
- **T2's scout gate was never exercised** — the agent refused on its own contract before invoking Bash, so `scout-readonly-gate.py` denial text was not captured.
- Only one file was actually created: `/tmp/teams-smoke-1791234533/w.txt` (by T3).
